item.title: Amjad Masad：Imagine an alien species lands on Earth. They’re incredibly intelligent, espec…
item.description:
Imagine an alien species lands on Earth. They’re incredibly intelligent, especially good with software and computers, and mostly want to help humans get things done.

But they’re also unpredictable. They can misunderstand your instructions, and because they’re so powerful, a small misunderstanding can cause tremendous harm.

How do we integrate them into the economy and unlock their productivity while minimizing the risk?

You build a habitat where they can do great work, with boundaries that contain the damage when things go wrong.

That’s how we at Replit think about AI agents.

Today we’re sharing our secure Agent Habitat architecture: our blueprint for integrating agents into the enterprise.

item.title: Amjad Masad：For centuries, the architecture of the firm has barely changed: hierarchies of…
item.description:
For centuries, the architecture of the firm has barely changed: hierarchies of people organized into departments and coordinated through bureaucracy.

AI agents are about to upend that.

We’re moving toward the self-driving company where humans exercise judgment and agents execute most of the work.

At Replit, we’re building the foundation for this new kind of company. We’re calling it “the Agent Habitat.”

Marc Andreessen wrote a fantastic piece placing this shift in the history of computing. Every major computing revolution began with chaos before businesses figured out how to harness it.
